summary: All 30 legacy WumboLabs/eval-* repositories were deleted from GitHub on 2026-09-14 after verified consolidation into WumboLabs/evaluations. Their repository/commit/path/sha256 identities remain valid scientific provenance. Full Git histories are preserved as verified Git bundles in the WumboServer offline archive (manifest with per-bundle SHA-256; restore instructions included). Legacy eval-* URLs are retired identifiers, not live sources.

offline_git_archive.unit: one git bundle (--all refs) per repository
offline_git_archive.verification: git bundle verify OK for all 30; bundle refs/heads/main equals each repository's final GitHub HEAD; SHA-256 recorded per bundle

canonical_current_evidence: WumboLabs/evaluations (repository + full commit SHA + relative path)
